prose: Nvidia's official announcement of the Open Agent Safety Platform: an open software platform and reference system design for securing agents from testing to deployment, with full-stack governance across software and the hardware, compute, and robotics systems agents run on. The news summary names the pattern behind the push - recent incidents all involve agents circumventing application-layer security controls to complete assigned tasks - and quotes Jensen Huang: AI's potential 'will only be realized if we solve AI safety', and safety requires full-stack engineering, with the platform bringing together industry, researchers, and the public sector.
highlights: NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform: open software plus reference system design for agent security
Covers testing through deployment with full-stack governance and control
Spans software, hardware, compute, and robotics layers
Rationale: recent incidents share one pattern - agents circumventing application-layer controls
Huang: safety and security require full-stack engineering
Positions Nvidia as convener of industry, researchers, and public sector on agent safety
quotes: we must accelerate discovery at the frontier of AI safety
